goal: Implement the core business features fully via API + sockets (UI not required yet).

depends_on_outputs_from: RealTimeSocketAgent: location store + location.handler.ts stub wired

tasks.title: Implement Haversine utility
steps: Create /lib/haversine.ts as pure TS function returning distanceKm
Add unit-test-ready structure (no side effects)
verification: Known coordinate pair tests can pass (later in QA wave)

tasks.title: Implement location persistence API
steps: Create POST /app/api/drivers/location/route.ts
Require auth via requireAuth or withAuth
Validate body with LocationUpdateSchema via validateOrThrow
Upsert into driver_locations for session.user.id
Return 200 successResponse
verification: Authenticated POST updates DB row for user

tasks.title: Implement nearby drivers API
steps: Create GET /app/api/drivers/nearby/route.ts
Require auth
Validate incoming lat/lng (query or from stored location) using LocationUpdateSchema
Compute nearby drivers within 50km using Haversine
Exclude stale drivers updated_at older than 5 minutes
Return only { id, name, latitude, longitude, distanceKm }
verification: Returns filtered nearby drivers with correct radius and staleness filtering

tasks.title: Complete update_location socket handler
steps: Implement /sockets/handlers/location.handler.ts
Validate payload with LocationUpdateSchema using validateSocketEvent
Update in-memory store entry for socket.data.userId
Compute nearby connected drivers (50km, exclude stale >5 min) using store + haversine
Emit nearby_driver_update to affected clients
verification: Two authenticated socket clients receive nearby_driver_update changes after location updates

depends_on_outputs_from: RealTimeSocketAgent: voice.handler.ts stub wired + location store provides socketId lookup
SecurityRateLimitingAgent: limits already in place for routes/events

tasks.title: Implement MediaRecorder hook
steps: Create /hooks/useVoiceRecorder.ts
Expose start(), stop(), isRecording, audioBlob, durationSeconds
Auto-stop at 60 seconds via timer
Handle permission errors gracefully
verification: Hook records and returns a Blob; auto-stops at 60s

tasks.title: Implement audio upload API (local storage for now)
steps: Create POST /app/api/upload/audio/route.ts
Require auth
Accept multipart/form-data audio blob
Store file with UUID filename under /public/uploads
Return { audioUrl }
Enforce max file size (10MB) and audio MIME type
verification: Returns an accessible audioUrl that can be fetched

tasks.title: Implement voice message API endpoints
steps: Create /app/api/voice-messages/route.ts
POST: validate body via validateOrThrow(VoiceMessageSchema), insert row with status='delivered'
GET: return inbox for receiver_id=session.user.id, ordered desc
Create /app/api/voice-messages/[id]/status/route.ts
PATCH: enforce receiver ownership, set status='listened'

tasks.title: Complete send_voice_message socket handler
steps: Implement /sockets/handlers/voice.handler.ts
Validate payload with VoiceMessageSchema via validateSocketEvent
Insert voice message row
Lookup receiver socketId from in-memory store
Emit voice_message_received to receiver with message metadata
verification: Receiver gets real-time voice_message_received event within 500ms

depends_on_outputs_from: RealTimeSocketAgent: stress.handler.ts stub wired + location store

tasks.title: Implement stress signal APIs
steps: Create POST /app/api/stress-signals/route.ts (auth + validate StressSignalSchema + insert status='active')
Create GET /app/api/stress-signals/active/route.ts (auth + radius filter 50km + exclude older than 30 minutes + status='active')
Create PATCH /app/api/stress-signals/[id]/resolve/route.ts (auth + creator ownership + set status='resolved')
verification: POST returns 201, GET returns only active recent nearby, PATCH enforces ownership

tasks.title: Implement expiry utility
steps: Create /lib/stress-signal-expiry.ts
Provide a function that resolves stale active signals older than 30 minutes
Keep it callable from cron later or on-read
verification: Utility can be invoked and updates rows as expected (unit testable)

tasks.title: Complete send_stress_signal socket handler
steps: Implement /sockets/handlers/stress.handler.ts
Validate payload with StressSignalSchema
Insert stress signal row status='active'
Compute nearby connected drivers using in-memory store + haversine
Emit stress_signal_alert to nearby drivers within 500ms
verification: Nearby connected users receive stress_signal_alert within 500ms

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint E — Feature Gate (No UI Required)
must_pass: Location update API persists and socket nearby_driver_update works between two users
Voice upload returns audioUrl; voice message persists; receiver gets socket notification; listened status enforces ownership
Stress signal persists; nearby receivers get real-time alert; active list filters by radius and 30-minute window; resolve works with ownership
manual_verification: Use two browser sessions or two socket.io-client scripts with different users to validate end-to-end events

stop_condition_to_advance: All three features function end-to-end via API + sockets with correct validation, auth, rate limits, and latency targets.
